biotools.summary: ChemGenXplore is a web-based Shiny application for interactive exploration and analysis of chemical genomic screens, supporting visualization of phenotypic profiles, gene-gene and condition-condition correlations, GO/KEGG enrichment analysis, and interactive heatmaps on both pre-implemented and user-uploaded datasets.
